auslastung.text: How hard Ablago’s container is working right now. Measured every minute; the curves show the last hour and are lost on a restart.
auslastung.nicht-verfuegbar.hilfe: Can’t be read in the container – Ablago doesn’t guess.
auslastung.keine-kurve: The curve appears after two minutes.
auslastung.kurve: {titel} of the last {anzahl} minutes, at most {hoechst}
auslastung.kurve.live: {titel} of the last {anzahl} measurements (every 2 seconds), at most {hoechst}
auslastung.keine-kurve.live: The curve appears after the second measurement.
cpu.kerne_one: Share of {anzahl} allowed core of the container
cpu.kerne_other: Share of {anzahl} allowed cores of the container
cpu.kerne.ohne_one: Share of {anzahl} core (no limit set for the container)
cpu.kerne.ohne_other: Share of {anzahl} cores (no limit set for the container)
cpu.last: System load of the computer: {eins} · {fuenf} · {fuenfzehn} (1, 5, 15 minutes) with {kerne} cores
speicher.ohne-grenze: {belegt} used – no limit set for the container, compared with the whole computer ({grenze})
speicher.datenbank.extern: The database runs outside this container – Ablago can’t see its load.
schleife.hilfe: This is how long a request had to wait because the server was busy computing something else (event loop). Details below under
warnung.schleife: For at least 5 minutes, the server often had to wait longer than 100 ms before it could process a request (in 99 % of measurements).
warnung.cpu: The CPU has been more than 90 % busy for at least 5 minutes.
warnung.speicher: Memory has been more than 90 % used for at least 5 minutes.
warnung.text: Ablago then reacts slowly. Typical causes: text recognition is working through many scans, demo data is being created, large exports are running, a package is computing a lot or the container’s limit is too tight.
arbeiter.aus: DMS_ARBEITER=0: PDF work and large exports run in the main thread. Other users then wait while they run.
arbeiter.hilfe.vorgabe: Stamping, editing pages, redacting, shrinking, PDF exports and large tables run here instead of in the main thread. Default with {kerne} cores: {groesse} workers, adjustable with DMS_ARBEITER. A job may take at most {minuten} minutes.
arbeiter.hilfe.umgebung: Stamping, editing pages, redacting, shrinking, PDF exports and large tables run here instead of in the main thread. Set with DMS_ARBEITER: {groesse} workers (with {kerne} cores). A job may take at most {minuten} minutes.
arbeiter.meldung.herunter: The server is shutting down. Please try again in a moment.
arbeiter.meldung.voll: Very many PDF jobs and exports are running right now. Please try again in a minute.
arbeiter.meldung.zeit.minuten_one: Processing took longer than {anzahl} minute and was cancelled.
arbeiter.meldung.zeit.minuten_other: Processing took longer than {anzahl} minutes and was cancelled.
arbeiter.meldung.zeit.sekunden_one: Processing took longer than {anzahl} second and was cancelled.
arbeiter.meldung.zeit.sekunden_other: Processing took longer than {anzahl} seconds and was cancelled.
arbeiter.meldung.uebergabe: The job couldn’t be passed to the worker: {fehler}
arbeiter.meldung.speicher: Processing needed more memory than allowed and was cancelled. Is the file very large?
verbindungen.umgebung: At most {max} at once (set with DMS_DB_VERBINDUNGEN).
verbindungen.warten: Waiting for a free connection in the last minute: typically {median}, at most {max}.
verbindungen.keine: No measurements yet for waiting for a connection.
verbindungen.hilfe: Every 5 seconds Ablago measures how long a small query waits for a free connection. If that is often over 50 ms although CPU and database aren’t busy, more connections help (DMS_DB_VERBINDUNGEN, see manual).
grenzen.text: For viewing only. You set them as environment variables in the Compose file; they apply as soon as the container has been recreated. The defaults suit households and small businesses.
grenzen.aufgeteilt: together for {prozesse} processes: leader {leiter}, each further one {andere}
zwischenspeicher.aus: Caches switched off (DMS_ZWISCHENSPEICHER=aus): counts, numbers of results and dates are calculated afresh on every request. This is meant for troubleshooting and makes Ablago slower – remove the variable again afterwards.
engpass.schleife: The server often had to wait a long time before it could process a request. If it computes PDF work and exports itself, {variable} helps (now {wert}): the workers take the heavy work off it. If the CPU is fully busy anyway, only more computing time for the container helps.
engpass.verbindungen: Queries typically wait longer than {ms} for a free database connection. {variable} gives more connections (now {wert}) – only useful if CPU and database aren’t busy.
engpass.arbeiter: The workers’ queue was full in the last {minuten} minutes; PDF jobs or exports were rejected. {variable} gives more workers (now {wert}) – only useful with free cores.
engpass.ueberlast: In the last {minuten} minutes more than {wert} requests ran at once; further ones got “very busy right now”. The limit is {variable}. First check whether a program (e.g. via WebDAV) is sending unusually many requests – a higher limit won’t make Ablago faster.
ueberlast.meldung: Ablago is very busy right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
erweiterung.trgm.fehlt: The extension pg_trgm is missing in the database. The search therefore shows no similar spellings and no “Did you mean …?” for typos, and searching for parts of words is slower.
erweiterung.trgm.abhilfe: Ablago creates it on every start in the schema erweiterungen_dms. If that fails, the database user lacks the CREATE permission on the database, or the database server lacks the postgresql-contrib package. Then restart Ablago.
erweiterung.unaccent.fehlt: The extension unaccent is missing in the database. Ablago therefore folds umlauts, accents and ß itself – only the common letters.
erweiterung.unaccent.abhilfe: The search works anyway. The images postgres:17 and dms-komplett include unaccent; for your own database it is part of the postgresql-contrib package.
erweiterung.gefaehrdet: The extension {name} is in the schema {schema}. A restore would delete it too, and the search would then be worse.
erweiterung.gefaehrdet.abhilfe: Ablago moves it into the schema erweiterungen_dms on every start. If that fails, it belongs to another database user – then whoever manages the database moves it (see manual).
erweiterung.uebersicht: A database extension is missing or at risk – the search works worse than it could.
prozesse.text: With DMS_PROZESSE several processes answer the requests. Process 1 also does the background work (text recognition, thumbnails, schedules, package runner, backup). A crashed process restarts by itself; you stay signed in. Computing time as a percentage of one core since the last query.
extern.text: How long Ablago waits for other services: AI service, mailbox retrieval, email sending, sign-in through a provider and network access by packages. So you can see whether it is Ablago, the network or the service.
extern.keine_one: Ablago has not called an external service in the last hour.
extern.keine_other: Ablago has not called an external service in the last {anzahl} hours.
extern.datenschutz: Only service, package, function, person, duration, data volume, result and tokens are stored – never questions, answers, emails, addresses or links. None of it leaves Ablago.
extern.budget.warnung: {prozent} % of the monthly budget for AI services has been used ({summe} of {budget}).
extern.budget.erreicht: The monthly budget for AI services has been reached ({summe} of {budget}). Without a hard limit the AI features keep running.
extern.budget.pausiert: The monthly budget for AI services has been reached ({summe} of {budget}). Paid AI features are paused until {datum}.
extern.paket.text: Network calls of this package: time to first response and in total, errors, data volume and – for an AI service – tokens. Without content.
extern.kosten.text: What AI services cost in a month – estimated from the tokens the service reports in each response and the price you enter per package. The provider's invoice may differ. Local services (e.g. Ollama) count tokens but cost nothing.
extern.kosten.teuerste.leer: No requests this month. Individual requests are kept for {tage} days, then only the totals.
extern.kosten.leer: No calls to AI services this month.
extern.kosten.lokal: No calls to an AI service this month yet.
extern.kosten.keine-pakete: No AI package is installed (a package with content and network access). You enter prices once there is one.
extern.kosten.preis-hinweis: You will find the prices in the provider's price list. Empty or 0: free, e.g. a local service. A new price applies to calls from now on.
extern.kosten.budget.hinweis: From {prozent} % Ablago warns here and in the log. Empty: no budget.
extern.kosten.hart: Hard limit: pause AI features when reached
extern.kosten.hart.hinweis: Paid AI features (packages with a price) pause until the start of next month. Anyone using them sees “AI features paused until …”. Events wait and are delivered afterwards. A higher budget lifts the pause at once.
extern.kosten.datenschutz: Only metadata, never content. Individual calls are kept for {tage} days, then only monthly totals; monthly totals for {monate} months. If an account is deleted, its figures remain without the person.
